about: The vale's folk (src/app/94-garden-folk-0rules.js): their small homes, placed through layout data like any thing of a kind (src/app/94-garden-zz-7act-0kinds.js burrow, holt), each painted into its ground (src/app/94-garden-folk-2art.js). Not part of the saved-world identity. Who lives where is worked out by kind (a burrow, a holt, any cottage), never by these ids: a layout without these rows still houses everyone. Check with: node tools/folk-audit.mjs and node tools/affordance-audit.mjs

things.note: Tam's burrow: a door in a grassy bank north-west of the old chapel, on open grass off the ruins lane
Pip's holt: in the roots of the bank above the water by the boathouse (the mill race banks are all path, plot and paving: no clear ground for it there)
